project_type: Next.js 16 (App Router, Turbopack) monolith — admin panel + public storefront + REST API routes; Prisma ORM + PostgreSQL; Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui (Base UI). Single package, no workspaces.
build_system: npm. Build: `npm run build` = `prisma generate && next build` (Turbopack). Type-check: `npx tsc --noEmit`. Lint: `npm run lint` (eslint flat config, next core-web-vitals + typescript). Path alias `@/* -> ./src/*`.
test_framework: None installed (no vitest/jest/playwright). Verification is build + type-check + lint, NOT unit tests.
verification_instructions: Per feature: run `npx tsc --noEmit` (must exit 0). Do NOT expect `npm run build` to pass mid-task — it only goes green once ALL features are done (because the old client pages use useSearchParams/use(params) without Suspense and are rewritten feature-by-feature). Final convergence: run `npx prisma generate`, `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npm run build` (must exit 0), `npm run lint` (errors forbidden, warnings OK). The `images.domains` deprecation and `middleware` deprecation print as warnings — allowed. No DB is needed to build because all server pages set `export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'` and Cache Components is disabled.
snapshot_or_generated_files: prisma generate produces node_modules/.prisma/client (gitignored, not committed). No checked-in generated files. Run `npx prisma generate` before building/tsc so @prisma/client types exist.
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell. `&&` is NOT a valid separator in the default PowerShell — chain commands with `;` or run them separately, or use the tool's cwd param. The repo currently FAILS `npm run build` due to `cacheComponents: true`; FEAT-001 disables it. next.config.ts `images` remotePatterns already allows any https host — use next/image for product images. Seed data has `images: []` for every product, so the emoji 🪑 fallback is the common render path; next/image is still required for when image URLs exist.
contribution_requirements: Do NOT modify: prisma/schema.prisma, src/lib/prisma.ts, src/lib/utils.ts, src/lib/auth.ts, src/middleware.ts, prisma/seed.ts, anything under src/app/admin/**, anything under src/app/api/**, src/app/layout.tsx, any src/components/ui/*. The ONLY pre-existing file allowed to change is next.config.ts (set cacheComponents:false and partialPrefetching:false). Reuse formatCurrency/formatDate/generateSlug/etc from src/lib/utils.ts. Commit each feature locally on the branch with a descriptive message; never push. Bengali UI labels throughout the customer site.
key_patterns: Server components = async function, call prisma via `@/lib/prisma`, set `export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'` to avoid build-time DB. Client components = `'use client'` + useState/useEffect + fetch to existing /api routes + react-hot-toast. Styling = raw Tailwind v4 utility classes with warm amber palette (bg-amber-50/100, accents amber-600/700/800/900 + orange-50/600, text gray-700/800), cards `bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-amber-100`, skeletons `animate-pulse`, truncate `line-clamp-2`. Toast via react-hot-toast with `<Toaster position="top-right"/>` per layout. SessionProvider is added per section layout (root layout has none). Images: next/image with emoji fallback when empty. Each (public) layout wraps: SessionProvider > CartProvider > SiteNavbar + main + SiteFooter + Toaster.
